title: Google Calendar event
description: Read one event from a Google Calendar.

config.label: Calendar ID
config.description: `primary` for the connected account's own calendar, or a calendar's id (usually an email address).
config.$comment: A calendar id is an EMAIL ADDRESS for most calendars, and `@` and `#` are legal in one (group calendars end in @group.calendar.google.com). Every emitter URL-encodes a path value, so it cannot change which URL is called.

config.label: Event ID
config.description: The event's id, as published by another node or by a notification's follow-up list.

outputShape.description: The description, when there is one.
RFC 3339 start. All-day events carry start.date instead.
